meta.name: press-release
meta.description: Write an Amazon-style press release that defines customer value before building. Use when aligning stakeholders on a new product, feature, or strategic bet.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用新闻稿形式定义产品价值，对齐团队认知
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在启动新功能前与利益相关方达成共识
copy.tagline_en: Define customer value with a one-page press release to align stakeholders
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to align your team on a new product concept before building

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 会帮您按照亚马逊「反向工作」方法论起草一份新闻稿。它从客户视角出发，先写标题、导语、问题、解决方案等段落，用来在动手开发前理清产品价值。
howto.when: 当您想对新产品、功能或战略赌注定义客户价值、对齐团队意见时，可以请 Claude 起草新闻稿。

say.text: 帮我写一份 SmartInvoice 的亚马逊风格新闻稿
say.note: Claude 会按框架生成完整草稿。

say.text: 给新用户注册功能写一篇 press release
say.note: Claude 会引导填写各段落。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to draft an Amazon-style press release following the Working Backwards methodology. It produces headline, dateline, problem, solution paragraphs, etc., from the customer's perspective, serving as a planning tool before building.
howto.when_en: Use this when defining a new product or major feature, aligning stakeholders on vision before development, or testing if a product idea is compelling.

say_en.text: Draft an Amazon-style press release for SmartInvoice.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a full draft using the template.

say_en.text: Write a press release for the new user onboarding feature.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through each section.
